title: 第1016章 天罗幻境第1015章 仿然如梦
content_zh:
随着叶霄炎的话音落下，叶霄尘脸色一变，死死盯着他，沉声道：“炎哥，都什么时候了，你还在说什么胡话？！”
看着自家族长大人那一副痛心疾首、仿佛自己做了什么大逆不道之事的模样，叶霄炎却只是轻轻摇了摇头，神色平静得近乎冷淡。
“你想玩，我不想继续玩下去了。”
淡淡的一句话落下，没有多余的情绪，却透着一种说不出的决绝。
下一瞬，叶霄炎周身陡然涌起一股狂暴至极的火浪！
轰——！
火浪冲天而起，宛若火海倒卷，瞬间以叶霄炎为中心朝着四面八方疯狂扩散开来。
只不过，这一次的火焰，却不再是先前那种灿金色的火焰，
而是化作了一种更加纯粹、更加炽烈、也更加令人心悸的白金之色。
白金火焰升腾之间，宛如星辰燃烧，神圣而霸道，恐怖的高温几乎在出现的刹那，便令周遭空间都隐隐扭曲起来。
这，正是圣星焚天炎！
圣星焚天炎一出，炽热的火光瞬间铺天盖地，仿佛带着焚尽世间一切的无上威势。
像是一尊沉睡已久的火中神只，终于在此刻睁开了眼眸，要以绝对的力量，将眼前所见的一切尽数焚灭！
而叶霄炎周身的一切，也在这股火焰之下，开始被迅速吞噬。
观战台。
广场。
石阶。
廊柱。
还有周围那些本该高高在上、在外界足以呼风唤雨的各大势力宗主、长老、强者……在白金火焰的灼烧下，全都没有丝毫反抗之力，连惨叫都来不及发出，便尽数化作了飞灰，消散在火浪之中。
那景象太过恐怖，仿佛不是人间该有的场面，而是天地崩塌、万物归墟时才会出现的末日景象。

片刻之后，叶霄炎周身的一切，竟全都消失得干干净净。
原本恢弘的广场，消失了。
原本森严的观战台，消失了。
原本密密麻麻、站满四周的身影，也消失了。
取而代之的，是一片无边无际的火海。
叶霄炎独自立于火海之中，白金色火焰环绕四周，将他衬得宛若火中神明，周身衣袍猎猎，黑发在火光中微微扬起，整个人显得格外冷峻而孤绝。
他脚踏虚空，神情淡漠，虽然直到此刻，他依旧不知道自己究竟身处何处，但冥冥之中，他却能够清晰感觉到——有人在注视着自己。
叶霄炎微微皱眉，目光扫向四周，沉声道：“还不出来吗？”
话音刚落，前方火海之中忽然轻轻一荡。
紧接着，一团火焰悄然凝聚，慢慢化作一道矮小的身影。
那身影起初模糊不清，随着火焰散去，终于显露出真容。
那是一个小孩。
准确来说，是一个由火焰幻化而成的小孩。
而这小孩，正是之前在传承之地外，自称秘境之灵的金霄。
金霄负手而立，站在火海之中，微微偏头看着叶霄炎，眼底掠过一丝明显的疑惑，像是实在想不明白，对方为何能这么快从幻境中挣脱出来。
他沉吟片刻，终于开口道：“这幻境，乃是根据你心中最真实的想法投射出来的。”
“寻常人进入其中，往往都会被心中执念牵引，沉沦百年都不为过。”
说到这里，金霄顿了顿，目光落在叶霄炎身上，带着几分探究之意，缓缓问道：
“你能告诉我，你是怎么发现出不对劲的吗？”
content_en:
As Ye Xiaoyan finished speaking, Ye Xiaochen's expression changed, he stared at him, and said in a deep voice: "Brother Yan, what time has it been, are you still talking nonsense?!"
Seeing the eldest son of his family looking very distressed, as if he had done something treacherous and unethical, Ye Xiaoyan just shook his head slightly, his expression calm and almost indifferent.
"You want to play, but I don't want to continue playing."
The words were spoken lightly, without any unnecessary emotion, but with an indescribable determination.
The next moment, Ye Xiaoyan's body suddenly surged with an extremely violent wave of fire!
boom--!
The fire wave rose into the sky, like a sea of ​​fire rolling back, and instantly spread crazily in all directions with Ye Xiaoyan as the center.
However, this time the flame was no longer the golden flame before.
Instead, it turned into a purer, more intense, and more heart-stopping platinum color.
When the platinum flames rise, they are like stars burning, sacred and domineering, and the terrifying high temperature makes the surrounding space faintly distorted almost the moment it appears.
This is none other than Holy Star Burning Sky Flame!
As soon as the Holy Star Burning Sky Flame came out, the blazing flames instantly covered the sky, as if it had the supreme power to burn everything in the world.
Like a god in fire who has been sleeping for a long time, he finally opened his eyes at this moment and wants to use absolute power to burn everything he sees in front of him!
And everything around Ye Xiaoyan began to be quickly devoured by this flame.
Observation stand.
square.
Stone steps.
Porch.
As well as the sect leaders, elders, and powerful men of the major forces who were supposed to be aloof and powerful in the outside world... they were all unable to resist under the burning of the platinum flames. They didn't even have time to scream, so they all turned into fly ash and dissipated in the waves of fire.
The scene was too terrifying, as if it was not a scene that should be seen in the human world, but a doomsday scene that would only appear when the world collapses and everything returns to ruins.
After a moment, everything around Ye Xiaoyan disappeared completely.
The originally grand square disappeared.
The originally strict viewing platform disappeared.
The densely packed figures that stood all around also disappeared.
Instead, there was an endless sea of ​​fire.
Ye Xiaoyan stood alone in the sea of ​​​​fire, with white-gold flames surrounding him, making him look like a god in the fire. He was dressed in hunting robes, and his black hair was slightly raised in the firelight. The whole person looked particularly cold and lonely.
He stepped on the void with an indifferent expression. Although until this moment, he still didn't know where he was, but in the dark, he could clearly feel that someone was watching him.
Ye Xiaoyan frowned slightly, glanced around, and said in a deep voice: "Aren't you coming out yet?"
As soon as he finished speaking, there was a sudden wave in the sea of fire in front of him.
Immediately afterwards, a ball of flame quietly condensed and slowly turned into a short figure.
The figure was blurry at first, but as the flames dispersed, its true appearance was finally revealed.
That's a child.
To be precise, he is a child transformed from flames.
And this child is none other than Jin Xiao, who claimed to be the spirit of the secret realm outside the inheritance land.
Jin Xiao stood with his hands behind his hands, standing in the sea of ​​fire, tilting his head slightly to look at Ye Xiaoyan, with a trace of obvious doubt in his eyes, as if he really couldn't understand why the other party could break free from the illusion so quickly.
He pondered for a moment and finally said: "This illusion is projected based on the truest thoughts in your heart."
"Ordinary people who enter it are often led by the obsession in their hearts, and it is not an exaggeration to sink for a hundred years."
Having said this, Jin Xiao paused, his eyes fell on Ye Xiaoyan, and with a hint of inquiry, he slowly asked:
"Can you tell me how you noticed something was wrong?"
